name: Tessara Handbuilt Moc-Toe Boot
description:
Tessara is a one-woman atelier operating out of a Tier 3 workshop, but her boots end up on Tier 5 feet. Each pair is hand-stitched in the traditional moc-toe construction — the distinctive raised seam running over the toe box — in vegetable-tanned deer leather. The sole is triple-layered natural crepe. Takes three months to commission. Has a two-year waiting list.

The underground luxury. No logo, no corponation affiliation, no marketing. If you know, you know. People who wear Tessara boots are tired of being sold to.
what_it_says: You found a maker instead of a brand. You waited. You understand that the best things aren't advertised.
worn_by: senior Tier 4 professionals with niche taste
story_hooks: Tessara's waiting list contains some of the most powerful names in Meridian — and she refuses to move anyone up. Someone wants to know why she turned down a Spire client.
A pair of Tessara boots was commissioned but never picked up. The buyer disappeared before they were finished. The boots are still in her workshop, paid for.
